meta.name: The Freelancer
meta.description:
Based on the book 'A Ticket To Syria', ex-Cop turned mercenary Avinash Kamath aka 'The Freelancer', takes up the daunting mission of rescuing Aliya, a newly married girl trapped in a war-torn Syria against the backdrop of growing ISIS terrorism

Complete series. On your server: S1 7/7

videos.title: SOS
videos.overview: Inayat Khan's death creates an uproar in the country. His friend, ex-cop Avinash Kamath, learns that Khan's newly-wed daughter, Aliya, has gone missing. He goes into action.

videos.title: Hell
videos.overview: Aliya panics after Mohsin reveals his radical plans and tries to escape. Dr. Khan warns Avinash about rescuing his friend's daughter.

videos.title: Flashback
videos.overview: Doctors advise Avinash about Mrunal's health. Dave and Patil learn who the Freelancer really is. In Syria, Osama Maqsood asks the Fazals about Avinash.

videos.title: Martyr?
videos.overview: Avinash lays the groundwork for Aliya's extraction from Syria. He establishes contact with her, and she helps him spy on the Fazals.

videos.title: Doppelganger
videos.overview: Worried about her fate, Aliya continues to spy during which Nabeela spots her secret phone. Meanwhile, Maqsood sends his men after Avinash, and Wilson searches for Aliya's lookalike.

videos.title: Death at the Doorstep
videos.overview: With no help from the CIA, Avinash gets IB to help him and readies his team to extract Aliya. While Aliya convinces Nabeela to back down, the CIA is on a mission of death.

videos.title: Touch and Go
videos.overview: Nabeela derails Aliya's escape and takes her place. When Avinash goes back for Aliya in the middle of heightened danger, the CIA executes their mission.
